scripts.test: pnpm run test:static && pnpm run test:dynamic
scripts.generate: pnpm run generate:sqlite && pnpm run generate:pg
scripts.drift: pnpm run drift:sqlite && pnpm run drift:pg
scripts.drift:sqlite: pnpm run generate:sqlite && git diff --exit-code -- sqlite/migrations && test -z "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- sqlite/migrations)"
scripts.drift:pg: pnpm run generate:pg && git diff --exit-code -- pg/migrations && test -z "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- pg/migrations)"
scripts.parity: pnpm --filter shared-core run build && pnpm run build && node ../../tools/scripts/db-parity.ts
scripts.test:dynamic: echo "test:dynamic: not defined for this package"
scripts.package: echo "package: not defined for this package"
